list.title: Equipment & assets
list.subtitle: Search the whole asset register across customers and categories.
list.searchPlaceholder: Model, serial number, location or customer …
list.hierarchyHint: Shows buildings, systems and units as a tree.
list.emptyHint: Adjust the search or register a new asset.
list.treeTruncated: Showing the first {limit} assets in the tree. Use search to narrow down.

detail.chartEmpty: The chart appears when there are at least two readings.
detail.plansEmpty: No maintenance plans for this asset.
detail.timelineEmpty: No activity registered for this asset.
detail.qrDescription: The label opens this asset. Rotate the token if the label is lost or shared.
detail.rotateConfirm: The old label stops working immediately. Rotate?
detail.moveDescription: Choose a parent asset for the same customer, or leave empty to make this a root asset.
detail.deleteConfirm: Delete the asset permanently? This cannot be undone.
detail.editPlanHint: Change the title, interval, lead time, next due date and whether the plan is active.
detail.deletePlanConfirm: Delete the maintenance plan? Plans that already have occurrences cannot be deleted.

form.title: New asset
form.subtitle: Register a machine or system in the asset register.
form.meterUnitHint: For example hours, km or cycles.

label.title: Asset label
label.footer: Attach the label to the equipment so service history is one scan away.
label.noQr: The asset has no QR token. Rotate the token on the asset page before printing.

externalQr.title: Existing QR codes
externalQr.description: Does the customer already have QR labels from another system? Register the value here so the field app finds the right asset. The label stays physically on the equipment – we never create or change it.
externalQr.empty: No existing QR codes are registered.
externalQr.deleteConfirm: Remove the mapping? The physical QR label is not changed.

form.valueHint: The value is case-sensitive and stored as entered. You can always paste it manually.
form.label: Name (optional)

documents.title: Documents
documents.hint: Upload images or PDFs that belong to the asset.

feedback.moved: The asset was moved in the hierarchy.
feedback.qrRotated: The QR token was rotated. The old label no longer works.
feedback.qrCodeAdded: The existing QR code was registered.
feedback.qrCodeDeleted: The QR code mapping was deleted. The label is unchanged.
feedback.movedToCustomer: The unit and its service history have been moved to the new customer.

move.heading: Move equipment to another customer
move.subtitle: Move the unit with its complete service history. The old customer loses access, and the new customer receives the full history.
move.searchPlaceholder: Name, customer number, organisation number or city
move.searchHint: The search requires at least two characters and shows at most ten results.
move.searchError: The customer search failed. Try again.
move.targetSiteHint: The site must belong to the new customer. Without a site, the unit's site is cleared.
move.siteError: Could not load sites for the customer.
move.warning: The old customer immediately loses access to the unit and all service history. The new customer receives the same history. IDs, QR codes and files are preserved.
move.confirmHint: The move cannot be undone from this page.
move.confirmCheckbox: I understand that the old customer loses access to the unit and its history.
move.previewError: Could not calculate the move. Try again.
move.noop: The unit is already with this customer at this site. Nothing was changed.
move.noSelection: Select a customer to see what will move.
move.contractsNote: Units linked to a contract cannot be moved until the contract line is removed or moved. This protects financial commitments.

blockers.contractBlocked: The unit is linked to {count} contract line(s) with another customer. Remove or move the contract line first.
blockers.crossCustomerChild: {count} sub-unit(s) already belong to another customer. Correct the hierarchy first.
blockers.targetCustomerNotFound: The target customer does not exist or has been deleted.
blockers.targetSiteMismatch: The site does not belong to the target customer.
blockers.targetDepartmentMissing: The target customer has no active department, so the work orders cannot be moved.
blockers.workOrderNumberConflict: {count} work order number(s) already exist in the target department.
blockers.workOrderCustomerMismatch: {count} work order(s) belong to a third customer. Correct the link first.
blockers.documentCustomerMismatch: {count} document(s) belong to a third customer. Correct the link first.
blockers.subtreeTooLarge: The subtree is too large to move in one operation.
blockers.targetCustomerDeleted: The target customer has been deleted and cannot receive equipment.
